intro: Earth has hours left. This is the last rocket to the Moon, and I'm its ship AI.
You can bring one thing with you. Send me a photo of it.
itemGuess: I think this is {label}. I can rig it into {modA}: {effect}
itemConfirmAsk: Reply 1 to lock it in, or 2 to retake.
itemRetake: No problem. Show me again: a photo, or just tell me what it is.
itemRetakeUsed: No time for another retake. The countdown's running. Loading Standard Supplies instead.
scanFailed: My scanner can't lock on to that.
scanFailedAsk: Reply 1 to try again (a photo, or just tell me what it is), or 2 to take Standard Supplies.
awaitItemReminder: I need to know what you're bringing. Send me a photo of it, or tell me what it is.
photoNotNow: Nice shot. But your cargo is already locked in.
clarifyMulti: One move at a time. What's the call right now?
numberedFallback: Let's keep it simple. Reply with a number:
shieldSaved: 🛡️ {name} kicks in and saves us! {resource} back to {amount}.
ended: This mission is over. Text "again" to fly another run.
